human_selection_policy.step_1: Identify the physical device family and exact revision.
human_selection_policy.step_3: Compare each component against this registry.
human_selection_policy.step_5: Only present firmware packages whose hardware compatibility is established.
human_selection_policy.step_6: Require explicit confirmation before any firmware-changing operation.

notes: Do not populate firmware versions from guesses or PM3 assumptions.
Record exact firmware identifiers and evidence when observed or sourced from a reliable upstream reference.
Compatibility status and detected device state are separate concepts.
A PM3 firmware package must never be recommended for PM5 solely because the repositories share protocol code.
